propositions: The undeclared-paths refusal message instructs to declare paths and retry, but declaring paths changes the file_impact hash and triggers stale-material refusal on the subsequent close attempt
Widening file_impact retroactively broadens the scope of an already-signed attestation, making it cover files the review never examined
The file_impact parameter is a direct input to the review process at four sites (pass1.py, det_lint.py, det_invariants.py, det_gate_rules.py), so new paths can introduce new review findings
The undeclared-paths message must be clarified to state that declaring paths is a material plan change requiring re-attestation via rebar review-plan before close can succeed
Both gates (undeclared-paths and stale-material) fire correctly as designed; the sole defect is the first gate's message underselling the required remediation
